description: This file contains unit tests for the UI API handlers of a Go-based web service, focusing on endpoint structure and response validation within the 'ui' package. It tests various handler routes like getting node summaries, node details, status, refresh, bulk updates, and dashboard summaries, using the Gin framework and mock dependencies.
